declaredBreaks.reason: PUT and DELETE /api/v1/mobile/push-notifications/installations/{installationUuid} now validate installationUuid as a UUID and reject other strings with a 400. Installation identifiers are server-generated UUIDs, and only the Lightdash mobile apps call these endpoints with the identifier they received, so no existing caller is affected.
